output.title: Renovated 5-Bedroom Villa with Mature Garden and Terrace in Strassen
output.description:
This detached villa offers approximately 280 m² of renovated living space, situated in a quiet residential area of Strassen. The property features a traditional Luxembourg architectural style with a white plaster facade and a pitched slate roof, complemented by an established, mature garden that surrounds the home.

Inside, the living room benefits from high ceilings and parquet flooring, creating an inviting atmosphere enhanced by a wood-burning fireplace. Large patio doors open directly onto the garden, providing seamless indoor-outdoor flow and abundant natural light.

The kitchen is designed in a transitional style with shaker cabinetry and granite worktops. A central island equipped with seating and a double oven offers both sociability and functionality. This space integrates well with the rest of the home, making it suitable for everyday use and entertaining.

The villa comprises five bedrooms, including a spacious master bedroom with fitted wardrobes and views of the garden. Three bathrooms are distributed across the property, serving the sleeping quarters with convenience.

Externally, the south-west-facing garden features mature trees providing privacy and a stone-paved patio for outdoor living. Additional amenities include parking facilities and a cellar located in the basement. The property is positioned in Strassen, known for its residential character, proximity to motorway access, and local schools.

highlights.text: Detached villa with 280 m² living space
Renovated kitchen with granite worktops and central island
South-west facing established garden with patio
